items.quote: The total capex planned for the greenfield project is INR220 crores, of which INR106 crores is spent till 30th September '26, and the balance is expected to be deployed over the next 12 months.

items.statement: Order book stands at INR760 crores as of 30th September 2026
items.quote: On the order book, as on 30th September 2026, our order book stands at INR760 crores, up from INR400 crores at the start of the financial year, providing healthy visibility for future execution.

items.statement: Order book execution timeline of 15-18 months
items.quote: The order book is expected to be executed over the next 15 to 18 months.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improvement to 28.1% in H1 FY27 from 23.3% in H1 FY26
items.quote: EBITDA for the period stood at INR55 crores vis-a-vis INR23 crores in the corresponding period of the previous year, translating to a growth of 139% year-on-year. The EBITDA margin improved from 23.3% to 28.1% year-on-year.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected to be maintained or improved in H2 FY27 and FY28
items.quote: Yes, our efforts are to make it better and better or at least maintain it. That's our effort and we see there is no otherwise reason for us to worry.

items.statement: Profitability expected to improve substantially with localized production
items.quote: So, I think we responded it a while back, right, that we definitely see an expansion in the margin once we have localized production, right? You save on the import cost, you save on the import duty, on the air freights, and plus the local overheads versus the overheads what we -- also the foreign fluctuation, that all gets reduced.

items.statement: Import duty and freight savings of 18-20% with localized production
items.quote: The cost saving, the import duty and the freight put together is today, say, 18% to 20%. That definitely goes away, plus the overhead difference, right?

items.statement: Price realization and product mix contributed to gross margin improvement
items.quote: Product mix and operating leverage, which is a combination of volume increase of close to 40%, better price realization, and cost efficiency measures, were the main contributors to the improved gross profit margins.

items.statement: No significant price erosion expected in next 5-6 years
items.quote: As far as bushings is concerned, we are a bit more hopeful because it is a niche product and it has got reasonable entry barriers. So, it's possible that -- and if you see the transformer companies have been announcing the investment as recent as last month also. So, if they are seeing a future post 24 to 30 months when their plants would be ready, and I'm sure everybody would be considering at le

items.statement: Order inflow higher than initial target of INR500+ crores for FY27
items.quote: And we are happy with this order book and we are making sure that this order book is also, we are also able to deliver on time and as per the schedule requirement from the customer. Next 15 to 18 months or it maybe say 18 to 20 months, we see this existing order book should help us to navigate and till then, we will also book new orders.

items.statement: Increased demand from both domestic and international markets
items.quote: In general as a bushing player we are seeing increased order inflow from all sorts of customers in India also and abroad also and that's the reason our numbers are much more than what we were originally targeting.

items.statement: RIP bushings accounted for 86% of revenue by value in H1 FY27
items.quote: By product category, RIP bushings accounted for 86% of the revenue, while OIP and high-current bushings contributed to 14%. Within the domestic sales, the contribution of the retrofit and services business has doubled from 4% to 8% year-on-year.

items.statement: Product mix shift expected with increased exports from India
items.quote: Till now, whatever is happening is as per our trend which we were doing and I believe that from the next year mid, we should be able to start booking export orders and that will probably change the landscape going forward from '28-'29.

items.statement: New entrants in high-voltage RIP bushing market
items.quote: Yes, there are a couple of companies who have announced that they would also come into bushings, apart from the Hitachi and CG type of customers. So, yes, we are aware that people are wanting to come, or they have announced investments. So, we are okay. We are prepared for that.

items.statement: INR106 crores raised from equity and warrants in H1 FY27
items.quote: Of this, 90.99 crores was received from the allotment of equity shares, and 15 crores was received upfront against warrants, taking the total fund received to approximately 106 crores.

items.statement: Maintain same revenue run rate for FY27-FY28
items.quote: But as per our order book and our business plan, we are planning to and we have a pipeline to maintain the same run rate.

items.statement: Second half FY27 revenue better than first half
items.quote: Because if you see my last 3 years business plan or my last 3 years comparison of the business, we have always been a Quarter 3 and Quarter 4 is better than the Q1 and Q2.

items.statement: Order book size Rs. 78 crores as of 30th September 2026
items.quote: So, as on date, the size number based on 31st, 30th September is Rs. 78 crores.

items.statement: EBITDA margin >50% for ZeroTouch product
items.quote: More than 50%-60% plus EBITDA margin we have into the ZeroTouch because it is a completely proprietary product.

items.statement: Margins sustainable for next 1-2 quarters
items.quote: So as of now, we see that at least for next couple of quarters, it will be manageable as we are scaling with our plan and our particularly business model.

items.statement: Margins may face pressure with exponential growth
items.quote: In going forward, if it will be a very exponential growth, that time it will be sometimes for initial period might be difficult to manage certain margins.

items.statement: ZeroTouch pricing based on volume of question papers printed
items.quote: So, the number of question paper getting printed by our device and delivered, according to that, we charge them. So, if they have more volume, definitely the charge is a little bit less compared to the less volume.

items.statement: ZeroTouch demand high in government sector
items.quote: So, our first priority is to move into the government examination, initiative examination, competitive examination, and the board exam.

items.statement: ZeroTouch revenue contribution 20-22% in 2 years
items.quote: So, our expectation in the next 2 years of line from ZeroTouch, we are expecting 20-22% revenue will be contributing by ZeroTouch.

items.statement: ZeroTouch revenue nominal in H1 FY27, picking up in Q3 FY27
items.quote: So, yes, we have started our revenue from ZeroTouch. It is, as of now, it is a very nominal stage. In the first half, we have booked revenue. And Q3, we are expecting a good amount of revenues as our exam is already started from this month.

items.statement: International revenue expected in FY27
items.quote: Inspirationally, we are expecting this financial year revenue from the international.

items.statement: ZeroTouch focus on government clients initially
items.quote: So, as of now, we are focused on the government clients. Because in the government, the two advantages we are getting, one is the mass and volume.

items.statement: International expansion targeting private clients first
items.quote: So, international, as of now, we are targeting private clients. And our model is our ERP solution to the school, college, and the university.

items.statement: International market entry involves initial marketing and cost pressures
items.quote: So, to manage margin is not that much easy initially stage. So, our focus is to first explore international market and then try to build a better margin ratios.
